description: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu inaugurates India's first AI-integrated command hub for pilgrimage ecosystem at Tirumala, enhancing crowd prediction, safety, and efficiency. Explore the latest AI technology in temple governance!
body_lead: Andhra CM inaugurates AI-powered pilgrim command control centre in Tirumala It offers crowd prediction and queue analytics, safety and security, cyber threat intelligence, operations centre of excellence and several other futuristic features. Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu on Thursday inaugurated an Artificial Intelligence-powered pilgrim Integrated Command and Control Centre at Tirumala.
